## Linked Tickets For Qodo + Linear

Qodo reads GitHub/Linear ticket context from PR descriptions and branch names.
Link every ticket this PR implements or fixes using one of these forms:

- `Closes #123`
- `Fixes #123`
- `Related to #123`
- `https://github.com/njrini99-code/helmv3/issues/123`
- `HEL-123`
- `https://linear.app/helmmmm/issue/HEL-123/...`
